summary: DXC still bitcasts a bool-matrix payload field's <N x i1>-vector-backed pointer to <N x i32>* and loads through it, assuming 32-bit-per-lane spacing where LLVM vectors are bit-packed; unchanged v1.6.2104 (oldest lib_6_6 release) through main and CE trunk. DXC's own validator accepts the output; the maintainers' unresolved position is that this is only unsound if DXIL is reinterpreted as standard modern LLVM IR, which is what the reporter's own opt-based repro does. No fix or resolution since the thread went quiet 2024-04-10.
title: Incorrect DXIL bitcasts generated for bool matrices in ray payloads
